themePreview.title: Turath visual system
themePreview.subtitle: Light and dark tokens from the brand palettes, glass surfaces, logos, and bilingual type. Use this lab to check primitives.
themePreview.paletteHint: Utilities map to CSS variables. Components never use raw hex.
themePreview.glassBody: Frosted panels with a 1px light edge and a large radius. Reuse GlassPanel — do not paste blur utilities on every card.
themePreview.bodySample: Turath connects travelers with verified Syrian stays, tables, trips, events, and guides. Cash on arrival. Arabic and English, from the first screen.
themePreview.logosHint: Main lockup when the nav is open. Compact mark when it collapses. Receipt mark only on vouchers.
themePreview.voucherHint: QR and backup code sit with the receipt lockup only.
themePreview.buttonsHint: Solid expands a color bloom. Glass sweeps a highlight across framed corners. Outline fills on hover. Hover and press them.
themePreview.inputsHint: Main keeps the label above the field and glows on focus. Glass is a filled 2px well. Plain is the compact search chip with a focus ring.
themePreview.selectsHint: Same three variants as inputs. Open the menu, pick a city, use arrows and type-ahead.
themePreview.controlsHint: Radio and check are the marks only. The switch uses the Uiverse track in brand colors. Tooltip prefers a side and flips if there is no room.
themePreview.tooltipBody: Cash on arrival. The voucher is a QR code plus a 6-character backup.
themePreview.segmentsHint: Same three variants as inputs, with size and radius. Works with more than two options. Arrows move the selection.
themePreview.datesHint: Same three trigger and menu variants as the dropdown, plus size and radius. Time uses an iOS wheel. Date opens a full calendar; tap the header to pick month or year.
themePreview.steppersHint: Same three variants as inputs, with size and radius. Type a number or use minus and plus. Arrows step the value.
themePreview.toastsHint: Success after a save. Info for an admin note. Warn at a plan limit. Error when a request fails. Neutral for everything else.
themePreview.toastSuccessBody: The site is live on the public map.
themePreview.toastInfoBody: Damascus listings pause this Friday for a city-wide heritage walk.
themePreview.toastWarnBody: You have used 9 of 10 featured listings this month.
themePreview.toastErrorBody: The request failed. Check the form and try again.
themePreview.toastNeutralBody: This notice is for anything that is not a success, admin note, warning, or error.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: The basic rules for using Turath, reserving experiences, and presenting your booking pass.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How Turath handles the information needed for accounts, bookings, safety, and support.

providerLicensing.title: Business verification
providerLicensing.description: How hotels, restaurants, trip organizers, event managers, and guides are reviewed before appearing on Turath.

legal.contactNotice: Questions about these pages can be sent through the Turath contact page. Final policies may be updated before the live service launches.

terms.introduction: These terms describe the frontend MVP experience. Completing a reservation means you agree to provide accurate details, respect the provider's published rules, and pay the displayed amount in cash on arrival.

agreement.title: Using Turath
agreement.body: You may browse public listings without an account. An account is required to keep bookings, vouchers, preferences, and reliability history together. Account details must be accurate and must not be used to impersonate another person.

bookings.title: Bookings and cash on arrival
bookings.body: Turath shows the list price, any valid discount, and the final cash amount due on arrival. A booking pass contains a QR code and backup code. Availability is held briefly during checkout and is confirmed only when the reservation succeeds.

responsibilities.title: Cancellations and guest conduct
responsibilities.body: Cancel as early as possible when plans change. Missing a confirmed arrival without cancelling may reduce your reliability score and booking access. Guests must follow reasonable safety, venue, capacity, and cultural-site rules.

changes.title: Service changes
changes.body: Listing details, opening hours, schedules, prices, and local entry requirements may change. Turath and verified providers should keep information current, but guests should confirm time-sensitive details before a long journey.

privacy.introduction: Turath collects only the information needed to provide accounts, reservations, arrival verification, support, and platform safety. This frontend currently uses mock data and does not send booking details to a production backend.

collection.title: Information we use
collection.body: Account information may include your name, phone number, email, nationality, date of birth, language, and currency preference. A booking may also include dates, party size, pickup choice, accessibility requests, special notes, or an emergency contact when the experience requires it.

use.title: Why the information is needed
use.body: Information is used to create and manage reservations, prepare booking passes, confirm arrival, calculate reliability, unlock verified reviews, prevent misuse, and help Turath or the provider respond to support requests.

sharing.title: What providers can see
sharing.body: The booked provider receives only the details needed to serve the reservation, such as guest name, verified phone number, party size, schedule, relevant notes, discount code, and cash due. Providers should not receive unrelated identity or account information.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You can change language and currency display preferences from your account. When the production service launches, account access, correction, deletion, and retention requests will be handled through verified support procedures.

providerLicensing.introduction: Turath reviews businesses before publishing them. Verification is designed to make discovery safer, but it does not replace government licenses, local regulations, or a guest's own travel judgment.

verification.title: Who is reviewed
verification.body: Hotels, restaurants, trip agencies, event managers, and independent tour guides submit an owner account and bilingual business information. Tour guides also provide their professional license number.

documents.title: Documents and listing evidence
documents.body: Applicants provide commercial registration, ministry or professional licensing, owner identification, operating details, location, contact information, a logo, and listing photographs. Documents are reviewed privately and are not displayed as public downloads.

standards.title: Publishing standards
standards.body: A published business must present accurate prices, capacity, schedules, amenities, location details, and booking policies. Verified status may be withheld when information is incomplete or cannot be confirmed.

status.title: Suspension and re-verification
status.body: Turath may suspend or remove a listing when licensing expires, information becomes misleading, serious safety concerns arise, or platform obligations remain unresolved. Reinstatement requires a new review by the Turath team.
